introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.p1: At doXmind ("we", "our", or "us"), we are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your personal information. This Cookies & Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our AI-powered writing assistant platform.
introduction.p2: By using doXmind, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy. If you do not agree with our policies and practices, please do not use our services.

personal.title: Personal Information
personal.intro: We may collect the following types of personal information:
personal.payment: Payment information (processed securely through third-party payment providers)

usage.title: Usage Data
usage.intro: We automatically collect certain information when you use our service:
usage.device: Device information (browser type, operating system, device type)
usage.log: Log data (IP address, access times, pages viewed)

content.title: Content Data
content.description: Documents and content you create, upload, or process through doXmind are stored securely. We do not use your content to train our AI models without your explicit consent.

cookies.title: How We Use Cookies
cookies.intro: Cookies are small text files stored on your device that help us provide and improve our services. We use the following types of cookies:

essential.name: Essential Cookies
essential.desc: Required for core functionality such as security, authentication, and session management. You cannot opt out of these.

analytics.name: Analytics Cookies
analytics.desc: Help us understand how visitors interact with our website by collecting and reporting information anonymously.

functional.name: Functional Cookies
functional.desc: Enable enhanced functionality and personalization, such as remembering your preferences and theme choices.

marketing.name: Marketing Cookies
marketing.desc: Used to track visitors across websites to display relevant advertisements. Only set with your consent.

managing.title: Managing Cookies
managing.description: You can control and manage cookies through your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to refuse cookies or delete existing cookies. Please note that disabling certain cookies may affect the functionality of our services.

useOfInformation.title: How We Use Your Information
useOfInformation.intro: We use the information we collect to:

items.provide: Provide, maintain, and improve our services
items.process: Process transactions and send related information
items.send: Send technical notices, updates, and support messages
items.respond: Respond to your comments, questions, and requests
items.monitor: Monitor and analyze trends, usage, and activities
items.detect: Detect, investigate, and prevent fraudulent transactions and abuse

dataSecurity.title: Data Security
dataSecurity.intro: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction:

items.encryption: Encryption of data in transit and at rest
items.assessments: Regular security assessments and penetration testing

dataSecurity.disclaimer: While we strive to protect your personal information, no method of transmission over the Internet or electronic storage is 100% secure. We cannot guarantee absolute security.

yourRights.title: Your Rights
yourRights.intro: Depending on your location, you may have the following rights regarding your personal information:

access.value: Request access to your personal data

objection.value: Object to processing of your data

yourRights.contact: To exercise any of these rights, please contact us using the information provided below.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.p1: Our service may contain links to third-party websites and services. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of these third parties. We encourage you to review their privacy policies.
thirdParty.p2: We may use third-party service providers to help us operate our business, such as cloud hosting providers, payment processors, analytics services, and customer support tools.

children.title: Children's Privacy
children.description: Our services are not intended for children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you are a parent or guardian and believe your child has provided us with personal information, please contact us immediately.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.description: We may update this Cookies & Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.
